requests.why: `--for 이유식`은 0건이다. 숟가락이 나오는 행위 클립은 둘뿐인데 둘 다 어긋난다 — act_large_meal_after_fasting은 식탁 가득한 그릇 앞에서 자기 입으로 숟가락을 쉬지 않고 나르는 과식 장면이라 '반 숟가락만 준다'와 정반대로 읽히고, act_shared_pot_dipping은 두 사람이 각자 숟가락을 공용 그릇에 담그는 감염 전파 컷이다. 이 편의 세 번째 갈림길이 '젖 먼저 → 반 숟가락 → 다시 젖'이라 숟가락에 남긴 양이 화면에 보여야 주장이 선다.

Only the puree is amber; the hand, the spoon and the bowl stay pale cyan. --ar 9:16 --no text, letters, numbers, numerals, printed scale numbers, printed label, brand marking, arrows, watermark, logo, UI, interface, opaque skin, photorealistic skin, face, head, body, figure, person, hypodermic needle, blood
requests.flow: One continuous shot in a single unbroken scene with no scene cuts. Only one translucent glass hand, a small shallow weaning spoon and a plain blank bowl of soft amber puree are ever in frame — no face, no head, no body, and nothing else enters the frame at any point. 0-1.5s: from the very first frame the spoon dips in and turns a half circle through the puree and comes up heaped and overloaded, and the camera rises from just above the rim and pushes in. 1.5-3s: the back of the spoon is dragged up the inner wall of the bowl and scraped along the rim in one long pass, and well over half the load peels off and slides back down into the bowl. 3-4.5s: the spoon is scraped along the rim a second time, shorter and slower, until a shallow half load is left sitting flat in the bowl of the spoon, and the wrist rotates to bring the spoon dead level so nothing tips off either side. 4.5-6s: the hand carries the level spoon slowly toward the lower edge of the frame and stops short of it, holding the spoon flat and perfectly still with the camera stopped close on it, the amber puree glowing softly until the very last frame; nothing else enters the frame and the dark slate blue-grey void stays empty. The hand stays translucent glass with the finger bones visible inside throughout. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows anywhere in the frame; nothing in the frame carries printed markings of any kind. The audio is a low synth drone with a soft scrape against the bowl rim on each pass, no music, no dialogue.
